Dacă ar face asta în Ucraina, ar putea ajunge la închisoare, relatează The Wall Street Journal.

latvia.title: NATO se pregătește să vâneze submarinele nucleare rusești fără SUA. Exercițiu militar în apropierea Islandei
latvia.description: Forțele aliate s-au adunat în apropierea Islandei pentru a exersa vânătoarea de submarine rusești, în absența unui membru cheie, scrie Politico. Distanțarea lui Donald Trump față de NATO s-a concretizat luna trecută în apele din largul Islandei.

latvia.title: Amenințare majoră pentru exporturile de cereale ale Rusiei. O țară vecină vrea să impună taxe vamale de 300%
latvia.description: Guvernul Letoniei intenţionează să impună taxe vamale de 300% pentru cerealele provenite din Rusia şi Belarus, în contextul intensificării transporturilor ruseşti prin porturile baltice, a declarat luni premierul Andris Kulbergs, informează Reuters, preluată de Agerpres. Anunțul vine la puțină vreme după ce guvernul de la Riga a interzis importul unor bunuri din Rusia. Guvernul leton …

latvia.title: ISW hindas Vene vägede edasiliikumise kehva tempot Donetskis
latvia.description: Venemaa diktaator Vladimir Putin on andnud oma vägedele käsu vallutada kogu Donbass 2026. aasta lõpuks, kuid tema nägemus lahinguvälja oludest on jätkuvalt kaugel Ukraina kaitsevõimekuse reaalsusest, teatas esmaspäeval USA mõttekoda Sõjauuringute Instituut (ISW).

latvia.title: Venemaa jätkas pärast kolmepäevast pausi rünnakuid Kiievile
latvia.description: Venemaa jätkas õhurünnakuid Kiievile pärast seda, kui lõppes USA saadikute visiidi ajaks kehtestatud kolmepäevane paus Ukraina pealinnale, teatas esmaspäeva hilisõhtul Ukraina päästeteenistus.

latvia.title: Ukraina droonid tabasid Taganrogi lennuväebaasis koptereid Mi-35 ja Mi-8
latvia.description: Ukraina droonid tabasid esmaspäeval Taganrog-Tsentralnõi lennuväljal Venemaa koptereid Mi-35 ja Mi-8, teatas Ukraina sõjandusele ning kaitsetööstusele spetsialiseerunud meediaportaal Militarnõi, mida vahendas uudisteagentuur Unian.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1658. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Ukraina droonid tabasid Taganrogi lennubaasis koptereid Mi-35 ja Mi-8
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1658. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: National bus strike threatened for next Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: The Latvian Passenger Carriers Association (LPPA), in cooperation with passenger carriers, will organize a protest action on September 16th, during which regional passenger carriers will stop providing public transport bus services commissioned by the state for one day, reports LSM's Latvian-language service.

latvia.title: Appeal for materials about Latvia's Jewish chess pastmasters
latvia.description: The Riga Jewish Community and the Museum “Jews in Latvia” are currently preparing an exhibition dedicated to the anniversaries of famous chess players Aron Nimzowitsch (1886-1935), Aleksandr Koblenz (1916-1993), and Mikhail Tal (1936-1992), as well as to the overall contribution of Jews to the history of Latvian chess.

latvia.title: Latvian National Guard chief believes he can massively increase its numbers
latvia.description: The Commander of the Latvian National Guard, Aivars Krjukovs, stated in the LSM series "Formā!" (In shape!) – which exists to portray a consistently positive image of the armed forces – that it is realistic to expect a combined force of 50,000 National Guards and reservists in Latvia in the future, and that realising this target is only a matter of time.

latvia.title: Suspected people smuggler caught in central Latvia
latvia.description: On Saturday, September 5th, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting people who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Nearly 20,000 vacancies in Latvia
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on September 7 show that in Q2 2026 the number of vacant jobs in Latvia stood at 19.7 thousand. The private sector recorded 10.5 thousand vacant jobs and the public sector 9.2 thousand.

latvia.title: Armenian Foreign Minister Mirzoyan visits Latvia
latvia.description: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, is hosting her Armenian counterpart, Ararat Mirzoyan, who is visiting Latvia from 6th to 8th September.

latvia.title: Latvian politician, director Rihards Pīks dies
latvia.description: On Monday, 7 September, Rihards Pīks, film director and former Latvian Minister for Culture as well as Minister of Foreign Affairs, passed away at the age of 84, his wife Sarmīte Pīka has announced.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Elīna Garanča in 'Adriana Lecouvreur' at the Vienna State Opera
latvia.description: On the evening of September 5th, Latvian Radio broadcast Francesco Cilea's 1902 opera "Adriana Lecouvreur" live from the Vienna State Opera, in which Latvian star Elīna Garanča reprised her role as the villainous Princesse de Bouillon.

latvia.title: Attempt from Belarus to bog Latvia down in burden of bureaucracy
latvia.description: Latvian Television's De Facto investigative show reports on a situation in involving vast amounts of unnecessary bureaucracy, reams of paperwork, sudden inspections and shady plaintiffs in absurd legal actions that is worthy of the great Ukrainian writer Nikolai Gogol.

latvia.title: Latvian obesity rate second-highest in European Union
latvia.description: Heavyweight statistics released by Eurostat on September 4th may leave many Latvians gasping for breath. It turns out that we are the second most obese people in the European Union.

latvia.title: Next few days will be summery in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will feel like summer over the next few days, but it will become cooler and rainier again in the second half of the week.

latvia.title: Daugavpils wants to revive unfinished bridge project
latvia.description: Daugavpils City Council has revived a road overpass project that is more than ten years old. The first phase, costing 12.5 million euros, was completed in 2020, but the planned second section is still at a standstill. Although there is no funding, the local council has launched a tender to ascertain the current costs, LSM's Latgale editorial reports on September 7.

latvia.title: LSM invites youth to media training project
latvia.description: Latvian Public Media (LSM) is inviting young people to apply for the new development project “LSM Starts”, which brings together the existing Public Media programmes – the Latvian Radio 5 DJ School and the Media Academy.

latvia.title: Rīga's Mežaparks locals unhappy with trees being cut
latvia.description: Residents of the Mežaparks neighbourhood have brought a legal action against the Riga City Council’s Urban Development Department, seeking to annul the felling of 87 trees to make way for the installation of cycling infrastructure, Latvian Television reported on September 6.

latvia.title: Good apple harvest this year in Latvia
latvia.description: This year’s harvest in Latvia’s apple orchards is good, but the bulk of the work – the harvesting of late autumn and winter varieties – is still to come, growers told Latvian Television on September 6.

latvia.title: Bicycle race participant dies in Latvia
latvia.description: A participant in the Vienība cycle race died on Sunday, 6 September, the Emergency Medical Service (NMPD) confirmed to the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 6th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Russian-language bookstore raided by Latvian security service
latvia.description: The State Security Service (VDD) carried out criminal investigation operations on Thursday and during the night of Thursday to Friday at four premises in Rīga and the surrounding area linked to the “Mnogoknig” bookshop chain, which primarily sells books in the Russian language, the service confirmed to the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Myths and Misconceptions
latvia.description: With Latvia's next parliamentary elections due to take place on October 3rd, we can expect a significant increase in the number of column inches (if there is still such a thing as a column inch) dedicated to Latvian politics in the international press.

latvia.title: Latvian police make another cigarette smuggling bust
latvia.description: Latvian State Police said on September 4th that at the end of August, law enforcement officers from the Riga Regional Department detained a known illegal cigarette dealer in the Ziepniekkalns suburb of Rīga.

latvia.title: Latvian auto sprint round postponed due to weather
latvia.description: Due to adverse weather conditions, the Latvian auto sprint round in Talsi has been postponed until next Saturday, 12 September, the organisers have announced.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: White Night, Homo Novus, Chris Noah
latvia.description: Although it is technically autumn (and it sure looks like it), there are still plenty of festivals and festivities to take part in!

latvia.title: Autumn exhibition season upcoming at Rothko Museum
latvia.description: On Friday, 11 September, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils will open its Autumn exhibition season, bringing together artists of different generations from France, Italy and Latvia.

latvia.title: Riga IFF reveals short film programme
latvia.description: The Riga International Film Festival (Riga IFF), which will run from 15–25 October has announced its Short Film Competition programme.

latvia.title: No swimming in Lake Saldus due to bacterial presence
latvia.description: The results of an additional sample taken from Lake Saldus on 31 August have once again shown elevated levels of microbiological (E. coli) contamination in the bathing water, said the Health Inspectorate.

latvia.title: School equipment charity drive helps hard-pressed families
latvia.description: The charity campaign “Let’s Help Prepare for School Together!”, organised by the Akropole shopping malls and the charity organisation Ziedot.lv, has concluded after taking place for the seventh consecutive year.

latvia.title: Heavy rain alert Friday in northern, western Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, a yellow alert for heavy rain and thunderstorms is in force across Kurzeme and much of Vidzeme, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Latvia to spend EUR 28 million on land mines
latvia.description: Latvia plans to allocate 28.3 million euros to purchase mines this year and over the next two years, the LETA news agency reported on September 3.

latvia.title: Rēzekne spa centre finds tenant after over 20 auctions
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, the oral auction for the leasehold rights to the Rēzekne recreation or spa centre came to a close. A tenant has finally been found for the property, which the local authority had been seeking for some time, according to the Rēzekne City Council.

latvia.title: Rīga Airport begins terminal expansion
latvia.description: Rīga Airport is preparing for major changes – the passenger facilities will be expanded and equipped with new technology, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: airBaltic plans to get loan of 257 million euros
latvia.description: The Latvian airline ‘airBaltic’ has reached an agreement with investors on a loan of up to 257 million euros. The aim of the financing is to strengthen the company’s liquidity and secure the financial resources required to implement its new business plan. The interest rate has been set at 25 per cent per year, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Another hack in Latvia, more public data leaked
latvia.description: Another official database in Latvia has been raided by hackers, it emerged on September 3rd.

latvia.title: One killed in three-car crash near Ikšķile, Latvia
latvia.description: One person was killed and two others were injured in a three-vehicle collision on the Daugavpils road between Ikšķile and Ogre on Thursday, the State Police told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Belarus conference to take place in Rīga
latvia.description: On Friday, 4th September from 10.00 to 13.30, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host an international conference titled 'Conference on Belarus 2026'. The event is organised jointly by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Latvian Institute of International Affairs.

latvia.title: Latvia and Canada pool resources on Nepal disaster
latvia.description: Latvia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs provided another update on September 3rd on the status of dozens of Latvian citizens believed to be missing in Nepal following a catastrophic flood.

latvia.title: Saeima tightens up Latvia's e-identity laws
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 3rd, the Saeima supported amendments to the Law on Personal Identification Documents and amendments to the Law on Electronic Identification of Natural Persons in their final reading.

latvia.title: No more 'veggie sausages' as of 2029 in Latvia
latvia.description: On 18 August this year, a European Union (EU) regulation came into force stipulating that terms commonly used in the meat sector, such as “meat”, “bacon”, “steak” or “fillet”, may no longer be used for plant-based and other alternative products, the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Dombrava, Kozlovskis survive no confidence vote in Latvian parliament
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, Jānis Dombrava, Minister for the Interior (National Alliance), and Rihards Kozlovskis, Minister for Transport (New Unity), survived a vote of no confidence tabled by the opposition party Latvia First and several MPs not affiliated with any parliamentary group.

latvia.title: Insolvency fraud case under investigation in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police have completed a pre-trial investigation into alleged fraud in the provision of insolvency services, in which 57 people have been recognised as victims. The total loss amounts to at least 81,304 euros, the police said on September 3.

latvia.title: Latvia's Groglass to be sold to America's Apogee Enterprises
latvia.description: Latvian high-tech company Groglass, which develops and manufactures anti-reflective glass coatings, is being bought by US company Apogee Enterprises, it was announced on September 3rd.

latvia.title: NATO will be projecting oak in Latvia over next two weeks
latvia.description: From September 5th to 14th, the NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia will be conducting drills with the name "Oak Projection" at the Sēlija military training ground.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: One month to go timeline
latvia.description: With exactly one month until polling day for Latvia's 15th Saeima elections on October 3rd, here's a rundown of a few important dates and deadlines over the next four weeks.

latvia.title: Dahlia paradise coming to Latvian Nature Museum
latvia.description: From 10 to 13 September, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History will host the exhibition “Dahlias 2026”, featuring hundreds of dahlias – including both classic varieties that have become favourites over the years and new breeds, the museum announced.

latvia.title: President meets Pope
latvia.description: President of Latvia Edgars Rinkēvičs is visiting the Vatican on 3-4 September.

latvia.title: Around 60 reports on possible election campaign breaches filed in Latvia
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) has so far received around 60 complaints regarding possible pre-election campaign violations. These have been confirmed in at least four cases, Latvian Radio reported on September 2.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Facts & Figures
latvia.description: Why have boring old imprecise political opinions when you can have snappy and exact political statistics? Here is a selection thrown up by October 3rd's Saeima elections!

latvia.title: Alūksne hospital helps local farmers get rid of surplus produce
latvia.description: 'Kabaci vajag?' or 'Fancy a courgette?' is one of the most typical questions asked at harvest time, when there’s a bumper crop in your own and your neighbours’ gardens – and the same is true right now of tomatoes and other garden produce. This prompted staff at Alūksne Hospital to reach out to residents, farmers and home producers, asking them to share their surplus produce and make donations so that the patients’ menu could be expanded, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Man arrested for sexual abuse of minors in Latvia
latvia.description: A man born in 1967 has been arrested in Jelgava on suspicion of sexually abusing five minors, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Jelgava prison becomes tourist attraction
latvia.description: Jelgava Prison, which is more than 150 years old, ceased operations this summer, but its doors are now wide open to visitors. Guided tours allow visitors to see areas that were inaccessible to the public just a few months ago, Zemgale Regional Television reported on September 2.

lithuania.title: The least free place on earth: Occupied Ukraine
lithuania.description: As discriminatory Russian policies permeate every aspect of residents’ lives here, many wonder what, if anything, Ukrainian will remain.

lithuania.title: Toroczkai Magyarnak: Azonnal kérjen, vagy ha már tegeződünk, kérjél bocsánatot, azonnal, és ne meneküljél gyáva, undorító féregként!
lithuania.description: A miniszterelnök arról beszélt, hogy Toroczkai fideszes haverokhoz járt lobbizni a minisztériumokba, mire a Mi Hazánk elnöke felcsattant.

lithuania.title: Pillanatok alatt kipakolták a Flippermúzeum kasszáját

lithuania.description: Állítása szerint még a feleségét is felhívták, hogy meggyőzze.

lithuania.title: Tomasz Siemoniak: raz jeden prezydent mnie poprosił
lithuania.description: Karol Nawrocki otrzymuje wszelkie informacje, tak jak poprzedni prezydenci - zapewniał w "Faktach po Faktach" w TVN24 minister koordynator służb specjalnych Tomasz Siemoniak. Mówił, że "raz jeden" podczas Rady Bezpieczeństwa Narodowego prezydent "poprosił" o większy materiał w jednej ze spraw.

lithuania.title: Kaja Kallasová reaguje na víťazstvo AfD: Strany, ktoré sú slepé voči ruským hrozbám naberajú na sile
lithuania.description: Šéfka diplomacie EÚ Kaja Kallasová v pondelok vo Vilniuse vyjadrila znepokojenie nad rastúcou popularitou strán, ktoré podľa nej ignorujú bezpečnostné hrozby zo strany Ruska. Reagovala tak na víťazstvo pravicovo-populistickej Alternatívy pre Nemecko (AfD) v zemských voľbách v Sasku-Anhaltsku.

lithuania.title: Cristian Deliorga, judecător CCR, Victor Ponta, Florin Manole - pe lista pasagerilor care au zburat cu un avion privat în Grecia
lithuania.description: Un judecător CCR, Cristian Deliorga, fostul prim-ministru Victor Ponta, fostul ministru PSD al Muncii Florin Manole, un senator UDMR, István-Loránt Antal, președintele Camerei de Comerț și Industrii, dar și oameni de afaceri controversați au zburat cu un avion privat pe insula grecească Mykonos în luna iulie, dezvăluie PressOne. O parte din ei - printre care Cristian Deliorga și președintele Camerei de Comerț și Industrii - au zburat împreună și la Nisa, cu câteva zile înainte, tot cu un avion privat. Reacțiile celor care au zburat cu avionul privat au variat de la a spune că a fost un „eveniment privat” (Cristian Deliorga), până la „Nu îmi amintesc - ce să fac? Sunt în vârstă” (Victor Ponta).

lithuania.title: Victoria Stoiciu, după ce episcopul Hușilor i-a interzis lui Călin Georgescu acțiuni politice în biserici: „Merită toate felicitările”
lithuania.description: Senatoarea Victoria Stoiciu laudă decizia episcopului Hușilor, Ignatie Trif, de a-i interzice lui Călin Georgescu desfășurarea de acțiuni politice în bisericile din eparhie. Reacția vine după vizita de sâmbătă a fostului candidat la prezidențiale în județul Vaslui, Stoiciu susținând că atitudinea episcopului ar trebui urmată și de alți ierarhi ai Bisericii Ortodoxe Române.

lithuania.title: Care ar putea fi următoarea țară atacată de Putin: România, vizată direct. Republica Moldova, una dintre ținte (Atlantic Council)
lithuania.description: Rusia duce deja un război hibrid împotriva țărilor europene, însă următoarea etapă de escaladare ar putea fi o operațiune militară limitată, menită să testeze disponibilitatea NATO de a-și apăra membrii. Experții centrului american de analiză Atlantic Council au evaluat unde și cum ar putea Vladimir Putin să extindă războiul dincolo de granițele Ucrainei. Printre cele mai vulnerabile direcții, aceștia menționează țările baltice și Polonia, dar și România, iar în scenariul polonez se menționează separat posibilitatea unui atac de pe teritoriul Belarusului. Însă și alte state se află în pericol.

lithuania.title: Cine sunt propagandiștii „spectatorului principal” Putin și câți bani câștigă: de la o fostă sportivă la un ex-consilier al lui Nixon
lithuania.description: La doar 15 ani, Maryana Naumova a uimit lumea sporturilor de forță ridicând 150 kg la presă în cadrul competiției Arnold Classic din 2015, desfășurată la Columbus, Ohio. Arnold Schwarzenegger a fost impresionat și a îmbrățișat-o pe tânăra minune rusă, care i-a spus fostului guvernator al Californiei că speră ca acesta să „devină președintele Statelor Unite și să pună la punct relațiile cu Rusia”, relatează The Times.

lithuania.title: SUA și China se pregătesc pentru un posibil război în spațiu. Sateliți „vânători” și arme orbitale, în centrul noii curse
lithuania.description: Pe măsură ce spațiul devine tot mai important pentru operațiunile militare, Statele Unite și China dezvoltă tehnologii care ar putea fi folosite într-un eventual conflict orbital. Sateliții capabili să manevreze, să urmărească sau chiar să captureze alte nave spațiale, armele antisatelit și sistemele de bruiaj sunt printre capacitățile aflate în centrul acestei competiții, arată Reuters.

lithuania.title: Președintele Congresului de Istorie a Religiilor, despre declarația lui Nicușor Dan privind naționalismul sănătos: „Nu pare că citește”
lithuania.description: Președintele Congresului Mondial de Istorie a Religiilor și membru fondator al Institutului de Istorie a Religiilor, Eugen Ciurtin, a comentat, duminică seară la Digi24, declarația președintelui Nicușor Dan despre „naționalismul sănătos” și a afirmat că, „deseori, la cel mai înalt nivel”, politicienii români „nu par că citesc”. Istoricul religiilor spune că sintagma trebuie privită cu prudență, întrucât a fost folosită și în discursul și publicațiile extremei drepte interbelice, inclusiv în zona legionară.

lithuania.title: Campanie pentru legalizarea industriei porno în Ucraina și o situație „tragicomică”: „Rachetele sunt dăunătoare pentru afaceri”
lithuania.description: La fiecare câteva săptămâni, Svitlana Dvornikova pleacă de acasă, din apropierea liniei frontului din Ucraina, și se îndreaptă către o vilă de lux închiriată pe coasta mediteraneană a Franței sau a Spaniei. Se machiază, își pune o perucă, pantofi cu toc înalt și își alege un pseudonim. Dvornikova nu se află acolo pentru a scăpa de război. Ea călătorește în străinătate pentru a transmite în direct show-uri solo către cei un milion de abonați ai săi de pe platforma online pentru adulți OnlyFans. Dacă ar face asta în Ucraina, ar putea ajunge la închisoare, relatează The Wall Street Journal.

lithuania.title: NATO se pregătește să vâneze submarinele nucleare rusești fără SUA. Exercițiu militar în apropierea Islandei
lithuania.description: Forțele aliate s-au adunat în apropierea Islandei pentru a exersa vânătoarea de submarine rusești, în absența unui membru cheie, scrie Politico. Distanțarea lui Donald Trump față de NATO s-a concretizat luna trecută în apele din largul Islandei.

lithuania.title: ISW hindas Vene vägede edasiliikumise kehva tempot Donetskis
lithuania.description: Venemaa diktaator Vladimir Putin on andnud oma vägedele käsu vallutada kogu Donbass 2026. aasta lõpuks, kuid tema nägemus lahinguvälja oludest on jätkuvalt kaugel Ukraina kaitsevõimekuse reaalsusest, teatas esmaspäeval USA mõttekoda Sõjauuringute Instituut (ISW).

lithuania.title: Venemaa jätkas pärast kolmepäevast pausi rünnakuid Kiievile
lithuania.description: Venemaa jätkas õhurünnakuid Kiievile pärast seda, kui lõppes USA saadikute visiidi ajaks kehtestatud kolmepäevane paus Ukraina pealinnale, teatas esmaspäeva hilisõhtul Ukraina päästeteenistus.

lithuania.title: Ukraina droonid tabasid Taganrogi lennuväebaasis koptereid Mi-35 ja Mi-8
lithuania.description: Ukraina droonid tabasid esmaspäeval Taganrog-Tsentralnõi lennuväljal Venemaa koptereid Mi-35 ja Mi-8, teatas Ukraina sõjandusele ning kaitsetööstusele spetsialiseerunud meediaportaal Militarnõi, mida vahendas uudisteagentuur Unian.

lithuania.title: NATO will be projecting oak in Latvia over next two weeks
lithuania.description: From September 5th to 14th, the NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia will be conducting drills with the name "Oak Projection" at the Sēlija military training ground.

lithuania.title: “Tā ir barības ķēde!” Slaidiņš skaidro Putina pavisam dīvaino runu par Ukrainas karu
lithuania.description: Krievijas prezidents Vladimirs Putins kārtējo reizi nācis klajā ar savdabīgu skaidrojumu par Krievijas sākto karu Ukrainā – viņš to salīdzinājis ar barības ķēdi savvaļā. Tā par Putina izteikumiem TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” pastāstīja NBS majors un Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš. Putins šādu salīdzinājumu izteicis tikšanās laikā ar Maskavas Valsts pedagoģiskās universitātes mācībspēkiem […]

lithuania.title: Ejam Trampa pēdās? Latvija plāno noteikt milzu tarifus Krievijas un Baltkrievijas graudu kravām un to apstrādei
lithuania.description: Valdība plāno noteikt 300% tarifu Krievijas un Baltkrievijas graudu kravām un to apstrādei, kā arī izstrādāt mehānismus iespējami zagtu Ukrainas graudu identificēšanai un sankcionēšanai, pēc koalīcijas sanāksmes žurnālistiem norādīja Ministru prezidents Andris Kulbergs (AS). Tāpat paredzēts nodrošināt iespēju pārbaudīt tranzīta kravas un sadarboties ar Ukrainas pārstāvjiem un laboratorijām graudu izcelsmes noteikšanā. Kulbergs uzsvēra, ka Latvija […]

lithuania.title: Ukraiņi izdomājuši jaunu triku ar droniem – Krievijas karavīri paši dodas slazdā
lithuania.description: Ukraiņi atraduši jaunu pielietojumu optiskās šķiedras droniem – tos arvien biežāk izmanto ne tikai uzbrukumiem, bet arī Krievijas pozīciju izlūkošanai, bunkuru un zemnīcu izpētei un pat pretinieka maldināšanai. Tā TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” par jaunāko dronu izmantošanas taktiku stāstīja Māris Bruža, Drone Force – Europe “Drone House” pārstāvis. lithuania.title: Krievija gatavo jaunu masveida triecienu vilni: jau ir zināms, kas būs galvenie mērķi
lithuania.description: Krievija gatavo virkni kombinētu triecienu Ukrainas enerģētikas objektiem un termoelektrostacijām rudenī un ziemā. Tiks izmantotas ballistiskās un spārnotās raķetes, “Shahed” tipa bezpilota lidaparāti un jauna veida klejojošā munīcija. Par to intervijā “Ukrinform” paziņoja Galvenās izlūkošanas pārvaldes vadītājs Olehs Ivaščenko. lithuania.title: Vyriausybė vyksta į pirmąjį išvažiuojamąjį vizitą Klaipėdoje
lithuania.description: Premjero Mindaugo Sinkevičiaus vadovaujama XXI Vyriausybė antradienį vyksta į pirmąjį išvažiuojamąjį darbo vizitą regionuose – dvi dienas truksiantį apsilankymą Klaipėdoje.

lithuania.title: Ukrainos generalinis prokuroras Ruslanas Kravčenka atsistatydina
lithuania.description: Ukrainos generalinis prokuroras Ruslanas Kravčenka pateikė atsistatydinimo iš generalinio prokuroro pareigų pareiškimą. Apie savo sprendimą jis paskelbė socialiniame tinkle „Facebook“.

lithuania.title: Trumpam sugrįš vasariška šiluma: vietomis šils iki 25 laipsnių
lithuania.description: Šiandien Lietuvoje numatomi gana ramūs ir šilti orai – daug kur dangus bus mažai debesuotas, o temperatūra vietomis pasieks 25 laipsnius šilumos.

lithuania.title: Mirė vokiečių bendrijos „Edelweiss“ pirmininkas Olafas Pasenau
lithuania.description: Mirė vokiečių bendrijos „Edelweiss“ pirmininkas Olafas Pasenau.

lithuania.title: Vidaus reikalų ministras: bus ieškoma būdų sulėtinti Rusijos šešėlinį laivyną
lithuania.description: Vidaus reikalų ministras Martynas Katelynas sako, kad Bendrijoje bus ieškoma būdų, kaip sulėtinti vadinamąjį Rusijos šešėlinį laivyną.

lithuania.title: Sybiha atkirto Lavrovui dėl „nacizmo Europoje“
lithuania.description: Ukrainos užsienio reikalų ministras Andrijus Sybihа atsakė į dar vieną Rusijos užsienio reikalų ministro Sergejaus Lavrovo propagandinį pareiškimą. S.Lavrovas teigė, kad Europoje egzistuoja „nacizmas“, kurį būtina išnaikinti, rašo „RBC-Ukraine“.

lithuania.title: „Alternatyva Vokietijai“ – pernelyg kraštutinė net Europos dešiniesiems: politologas įvertino grėsmes
lithuania.description: Partijos „Alternatyva Vokietijai“ pergalė Saksonijos-Anhalto žemėje sukrėtė artimiausius Vokietijos sąjungininkus. Nors regioninių rinkimų rezultatai retai kada vertinami kaip kažkas reikšmingo, tačiau šiuo atveju kilo baimė, kad pasekmes pajus visa Europa. Politologas dr. Gintas Karalius portalui 15min paaiškino, ar šis nerimas turi pagrindą.

lithuania.title: Zacharova pagrasino Norvegijai
lithuania.description: Rusijos užsienio reikalų ministerijos (URM) atstovė Marija Zacharova pareiškė, kad šalis pasilieka teisę „planuoti kovinį savo ginkluotės panaudojimą“ prieš Norvegiją, reaguodama į šioje šalyje dislokuotus JAV raketinius kompleksus, galinčius leisti tolimojo nuotolio sparnuotąsias raketas „Tomahawk“, pasiekiančias Maskvą.

lithuania.title: Kuba teigia dėl JAV embargo patyrusi rekordinę ekonominę žalą
lithuania.description: Kuba dėl JAV embargo nuo praėjusių metų kovo iki šių metų vasario patyrė rekordinius nuostolius, viršijančius 8 mlrd. JAV dolerių (6,9 mlrd. eurų), parodė komunistinės salos vyriausybės pirmadienį pristatyta ataskaita.

lithuania.title: Latvija planuoja 300 proc. tarifą grūdų kroviniams iš Rusijos ir Baltarusijos ir jų apdorojimui
lithuania.description: Latvijos vyriausybė planuoja įvesti 300 proc. tarifą grūdų kroviniams iš Rusijos ir Baltarusijos bei jų apdorojimui, taip pat sukurti mechanizmus, leidžiančius identifikuoti galbūt pavogtus ukrainietiškus grūdus ir taikyti sankcijas jų eksportui, pirmadienį po koalicijos posėdžio žurnalistams pareiškė ministras pirmininkas Andris Kulbergas.

lithuania.title: Serbijai laukiant pirmalaikių rinkimų, vyriausybė pasiūlė paleisti parlamentą
lithuania.description: Serbijos ministras pirmininkas pranešė, kad šalies vyriausybė pirmadienį pasiūlė paleisti parlamentą, atverdama kelią spalio mėnesį surengti pirmalaikius rinkimus, kurių jau seniai reikalauja studentų vadovaujamas protestų judėjimas.

lithuania.title: Lenkijoje surengtas robotų protestas prieš sparčią dirbtinio intelekto plėtrą
lithuania.description: Plevėsuojant vėliavoms, „skanduojant“ šūkius ir žygiuojant ratu: pirmadienį apie 30 robotų išėjo į Varšuvos gatves prie Lenkijos skaitmeninių reikalų ministerijos, "reikalaudami" dirbtinio intelekto (DI) reguliavimo.

lithuania.title: Savivaldybė pradėjo „Kauno švaros“, „Kauno autobusų“ ir „Kauno vandenų“ valdybos narių atranką
lithuania.description: Kauno miesto savivaldybė pradėjo trijų savivaldybės įmonių – „Kauno švaros“, „Kauno autobusų“ ir „Kauno vandenų“ – valdybos narių atranką, pirmadienį pranešė LRT.

lithuania.title: NYT: Ukrainoje dingo apie 1,2 mlrd. dolerių
lithuania.description: Ukraina 2024 metais dėl sukčiavimo, švaistymo ir netinkamo valdymo kariniuose pirkimuose prarado apie 1,2 mlrd. JAV dolerių (apie 1 mlrd. eurų), rodo konfidencialus vyriausybės auditas, su kuriuo susipažino leidinys „The New York Times“ (NYT).

lithuania.title: Ukrainos karinė žvalgyba pataikė į Rusijos lėktuvą Kryme
lithuania.description: Ukrainos karinės žvalgybos (GUR) Aktyvių veiksmų departamento pareigūnai naktį okupuotame Kryme atakavo Rusijos orlaivį. Apie tai departamentas pranešė pirmadienį, rugsėjo 7 d.

lithuania.title: Amerikiečiai: Rusija rodo „naują norą“ derėtis
lithuania.description: JAV derybininkai savaitgalį Kyjive vykusiose derybose Europos atstovams teigė, kad Rusija rodo „naują norą“ derėtis dėl karo Ukrainoje, pirmadienį pranešė Prancūzijos prezidentūra.

lithuania.title: NATO naikintuvai tris kartus kilo atpažinti ir lydėti Rusijos orlaivių
lithuania.description: NATO oro policijos funkcijas Baltijos šalyse vykdantys naikintuvai praėjusią savaitę tris kartus kilo atpažinti ir lydėti skrydžio taisykles pažeidusių orlaivių iš Rusijos, pirmadienį pranešė Krašto apsaugos ministerija.

lithuania.title: Rusija aštrina situaciją: davė Vokietijai 11 dienų
lithuania.description: Rusija pirmadienį nurodė uždaryti Vokietijos konsulatą Sankt Peterburge ir liepė diplomatams iki rugsėjo 18 dienos palikti šalį, taip atsakydama į Vokietijos sprendimą uždaryti Rusijos konsulatą Bonoje.
